stmarys_verger.text: St Mary's was founded in 1168 by Dónall Mór Ó Briain, on the site of his own palace. Bits of the palace doorway are in the west wall still.
Come and see the misericords: carved black oak seats from the 1400s. The choir could lean on the ledge during long services and look as if they were standing. Medieval ingenuity.

stmarys_carver.text: The misericords have all sorts carved under them: a wyvern, a swan, a boar, and a few creatures I wouldn't describe in church.
Twenty-three of them survive. The only medieval set in Ireland. I'm not allowed to touch them, which is a cruelty to a carver.
